message: Recommended minimal #2809 production closure: eliminate eager mutable neighbor execution and execute authority helpers only from immutable accepted bytes. Prefer reusing #2775's established replacement-blind exact-Git-blob pattern, binding provenance/private-review/generated helper bytes to the already owner-reviewed sourceCommitSHA, recomputing the Git blob OID before compile/exec, rather than adding independent mutable-path prechecks. If digest envs are retained, provenance and generated helpers need the same descriptor-read/hash/compile-from-captured-bytes custody as the current private-review helper; never hash then reopen pathname. Build guard must not import provenance/generated at module import; bind accepted modules only after accepted authority is available. Also remove `_load_accepted_private_review_module()`'s dependency on mutable `provenance._stat_identity` by using a local stat-identity primitive. Final field composition must cover installer-side direct provenance invocation and build-guard execution subject as well as inner helper calls. PHYSICAL NO-GO.
